Cost magnitude does not control admission. NEES now provides an explicit parameterized allocation-cycle model; the application author decides whether the cost is worthwhile.

cycleCountAuthority.branchRule: Predicted branch baseline is 1 cycle; add 15-19 cycles per modeled Zen 3 misprediction.
cycleCountAuthority.memoryRule: L1 dependent load=4 cycles; L2=12; L3≈47. Hot/local store uses the NEES 0.5-cycle throughput minimum only where explicitly stated.
cycleCountAuthority.limitation: These totals are additive accounting values, not guaranteed wall-clock latency. NEES governing-unit evidence remains authoritative.
